entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to start a return for a ProFit Jersey I bought a little while ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual size, but this specific jersey is just too tight across the shoulders. It seems like I got the wrong size, even though the tag is correct.
I understand. The ProFit line does have a more athletic, compressive fit. Can I get the order number to pull up the details?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It was delivered 82 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.

Alright, I've checked. Since it's a standard apparel item, you're well within our 90-day return window. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label now. You'll get a full refund once we receive the item.

That's great, thank you. Now, I do plan to place a new order for an exchange, just in a larger size. Since this has been a bit of an inconvenience, and I am a VIP member, would it be possible to get a small discount code to apply to that new order?

That's a reasonable question, and I appreciate you being one of our VIP members. While I can't generate a discount code for a sizing issue, what I can do for you is upgrade the shipping on your next order to complimentary 2-day express. That way, you'll get the new jersey much faster.
Okay, complimentary express shipping on the exchange works for me. That's a fair solution. I appreciate you doing that.

Of course. I've added a note to your account, so just give us a call when you're ready to place that new order, and any agent can apply the shipping upgrade. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
